split_rule: Within each dataset, sort SHA256(str(seed)|original_dataset|original_task_id), then rank modulo 5. Publish only supplied fold columns alongside task aliases; no claim that aliases regenerate the historical task-name hashes.

bootstrap.unit: task cluster within dataset, fixed OOF selections
bootstrap.rng: NumPy default_rng multinomial counts, first MATH then MMLU-Pro

empty_filter: retain maximum training completion rate ties, then training partial accuracy, then method identifier lexicographic
reference_numbers: Validation only; not loaded by selectors
